$comment: Runtime configuration for the ChatGPT Web Worker adapter. Relative paths are resolved against the worker directory by lib.js, so a clone runs from anywhere. ASCII-only: see the encoding note in lib.js.

paths.$comment_pwc: pwcLauncher is REQUIRED: it is the PowerShell launcher the adapter calls to run @playwright/cli with a pinned session name. The relative path is resolved against the worker directory by lib.js.

limits.$comment_timeouts: sendTimeoutMs bounds how long a committed packet may take to APPEAR as a user turn, and returns as soon as it is seen. completeTimeoutMs bounds wait_complete and must stay below the harness cliTimeoutMs, which kills the worker CLI process outright.
